name: thelia-backoffice-default-twig
description: Thelia 3 back-office Twig template — Bootstrap 5 + Stimulus + HTMX (served via Symfony AssetMapper)

comments.dependencies: bootstrap and bootstrap-icons are kept ONLY as SCSS/font sources for symfonycasts/sass-bundle (compiled by dart-sass, no bundler). All runtime JS is vendored through the AssetMapper importmap (see importmap.php). Run `npm install` to refresh the SCSS sources; the icon fonts in assets/styles/fonts are copied from bootstrap-icons.
